rows.en:
Whoa!? What are you doing?

…!?

He has the same eyes as that young man… Could it be?
What are you doing! Cut him down!

That voice… Birugenia?

I see… He's using the sword as a medium to control whoever holds it!

…!?

Wait! Birugenia!!

(…!?

This guy is nothing like the Gorgom monsters I've fought before…

That icy, cold gaze and that ferocious bloodlust…)
Kotaro Minami… no, Kamen Rider BLACK! This is the perfect place for you to die!

Shut up!

Using your own comrades as shields to get what you want, even mind-controlling people who have nothing to do with this… Such villainy, I'll never forgive!
Is that all your big talk amounts to? Here I come!
Heh heh heh… Can you keep up with these moves?
Ha ha ha…!!
Is this all you've got? Ha ha ha…
What's the matter? I'm over here!! Ha ha ha…

Which one is the real Birugenia?

It's no use… I can't tell them apart!!
Which one is the real Birugenia? Multi-Eye!!
It's no use… I can't tell them apart!!

Kamen Rider! This time was just a greeting!

The next time we meet… I will defeat you, without fail! Wash your neck and wait for the blade!
Birugenia… What a terrifying opponent!
Birugenia… What a terrifying opponent!

…!?

Be careful! He's a fast mover!

…!?

Be careful! He's a fast mover!
Gorgom's new assassin, Swordsaint Birugenia… A man with both strength and treachery, he was a formidable enemy indeed!
But, Kamen Riders! You must never lose!! To protect our peace and freedom…
Defeat the Rhino Monster!
Defeat Swordsaint Birugenia!
<c3>Ken Kurenai</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Ken Kurenai</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
<c3>Red Baron</c>'s HP went down!
Baron Full Power is Red Baron's last-resort weapon. If the battle does not end within 1 minute, Red Baron will explode.
With the giant robots' sabotage growing ever more vicious, the robots that should defend the Earth urgently needed to be strengthened.
With the TDF's approval, a plan was set in motion to mass-produce the super alloy Baronium and reinforce the robots' armor.

To conquer mankind… and build a robot empire, we must defeat Red Baron!

And now… that plan is complete!

With Brain's super-regeneration ability, we will repair and mass-produce Trojan Horse, and begin our attack at once!!
Heh heh heh… Our Naager will lend its help as well.
There's nothing here, is there?
That's strange…
This is Mari…
Did you find it?
Well… there's not a living soul in sight.

That's impossible!?

There must be an object emitting strange radio waves somewhere in that area! The signal has stopped for now, but…
I'll search the area now.
Please do…
Yes, sir…
That's…? Trojan Horse!?
But Red Baron already took care of Trojan Horse…
And so many of them?
Could it be that the Iron Mask Party has set up mass production of their robots…

Exactly right! Ken Kurenai…

We of the Iron Mask Party have joined hands with Brain! With Brain's super-regeneration ability, mass-producing robots is a simple matter.

That voice…? Dr. Deviler!?

Damn… Red Baron is an invincible robot! No matter how many Iron Mask Party robots there are, I'll smash them all!!

Ha ha ha…

I wonder about that? Ken Kurenai, good luck! Ha ha ha…
Damn…
This is Ogo… SSI, respond!!
This is Mari…
Powerful strange radio waves are being transmitted from Tokyo's District E! They must be controlling the robots.
Roger! Heading to District E at once.
All right, leave this one to me! Mari, hurry!!
What's wrong, Mari?
This is my mother's good-luck charm.

Mari…

All riiight, Red Barooon!!

Ken, are you all right?

Ken, listen carefully! This is endless! I'll leave it to your judgment! Use Baron Full Power…
I'll try!
Ken!
I'll be fine! Baron Full Power!!
Baron Full Power…
Ken…

…!?

Damn it, no!!
I did it!!
Banzaaai!!
Boss, Red Baron beat Trojan Horse in fine style!
Ken… Well done!!
Boss! What is it? What's this urgent business?
Mm, well, actually…
Look at this!
What?

This photo…?

It's my brother!
Is it really Dr. Kurenai?
I'd know my own big brother even if the picture was a little out of focus!

…………

If this is Dr. Kurenai… then your brother is alive!
What did you say!?
I took it just now… He was remote-controlling several Trojan Horses at the Iron Mask Party's secret base in District E!
Ken… Didn't your brother die back then?

uncertain: U08499: 青年と同じ目 — "that young man" is the man who held the sword earlier (U08493).
U08513: 首を洗って待っていろ rendered "Wash your neck and wait for the blade!" (idiomatic threat); could be "Get ready to die!".
U08518: 専劣さ read as 卑劣さ ("treachery").
U08534: 猫の子一匹 rendered "not a living soul".
U08540: [ja] unfinished; rendered "Red Baron already took care of Trojan Horse…".
U08553: Mari hands Ken a charm (implied action); kept as dialogue.
U08573/U08575: 紅博士 rendered "Dr. Kurenai" (Kenichiro Kurenai, Ken's brother).
